6958.de: A body of water leading from front to back to the right, with water lilies and a flock of waterfowl. On the left, on a rising bank, a group of old oaks. Behind, on the right, on the overgrown opposite bank, a deciduous forest.

7213.d: Mehe rinnakujutis, kibuvitsakrooniga pea pööratud vasemale. Taga paremal näha osa ristist. Detail maalist "Kristus risti kandmas".
7213.de: A man's bust, head with a crown of thorns turned to the left. Behind on the right part of a cross is visible. Detail from the painting "Christ Carrying the Cross".

7217.d: Seitse mängivat ja tantsivat putot. Ees vasemal puuvili, tagapool suureleheline taim. Taamal mägine maastik.
7217.de: Seven putti playing and dancing. On the left in front, fruit, behind it a large-leaved plant. In the distance a mountainous landscape.

7218.d: Keskel puu all istuv noor naine jälgimas tema ees kivil magavat last, vasakul kaks putot, paremal Joosepi figuur, kelle kõrval eesel.
7218.de: In the centre a young woman sitting under a tree, watching a child sleeping on a rock in front of her, on the left two putti, on the right the figure of Joseph, beside whom a donkey.

7228.d: Eest paremalt taga vasakule kulgeval põldude vahelisel teel XIX s. riietuses (maani rüüs paeltega kübaras) naine ja kaabus mees - selgvaates. Nende juures kaks koera. Kaugemal naine tütarlapsega. Tagapool üle põlde palistava põõsastikus näha kiriku katust ja torni ning hoonete katuseid.
7228.de: On a path between fields running from front right to back left, in 19th-century dress (a floor-length gown and a ribboned bonnet) a woman and a man in a top hat - seen clearly. Two dogs beside them. Further away a woman with a girl. Further back, in bushes bordering the fields, the roof and tower of a church and the roofs of buildings can be seen.

7234.d: Esiplaanil kõrgel nõlval jämeda tüvega lehtpuu all noor habemik mees maalimas, maalikast põlvel. Temast tagapool vasakul roosas kleidis noor  naine tegevust jälgimas, raamat süles, jalgade juures kübar, lamav kirju koer. Valgus langeb vasakult naise seljale ja puu alumistele okstele. Taamal paremal mägede vaheline org veekoguga sinakas vines. Detailitäpne viimistletud maalilaad.
7234.de: In the foreground, on a high slope, under a leafy tree with a thick trunk, a young bearded man is painting, with a paint box on his knee. Behind him on the left, a young woman in a pink dress watches the activity, a book in her lap, a hat by her feet, a spotted dog lying down. Light falls from the left onto the woman's back and the lower branches of the tree. In the distance on the right, a valley between mountains with a body of water in a bluish haze. A detailed, refined, polished painting style.

7305.d: Keskel ristilt võetud Kristuse figuur, haavadega kätel, jalgadel ja küljes, pooleldi istuvas asendis teda selja tagant toetava naisfiguuri najal. Paremal, Kristuse figuuri kõrval ingli figuur tema vasakut kätt hoidmas. Vasakul all nurgas kibuvitsa kroon.
7305.de: In the centre the figure of Christ taken down from the cross, with wounds on his hands, feet and side, in a half-sitting position, supported from behind by a female figure. On the right, beside the figure of Christ, an angel figure holding his left hand. In the lower left corner a crown of thorns.

7318.d: Pilvedes kaks inglikest maalimistarvetega büsti ees; kõrval lüüra ja palett, taga molbert. Kordustöö.
7318.de: In the clouds two little angels with painting implements in front of busts; beside them a lyre and a palette, behind an easel. Repeat work.

7319.d: Keskel kolm pilvedes hõljuvat inglikest, käes pikk valge lint. Paremal ja vasemal inglipaarid. Kordustöö.
7319.de: In the middle three angels hovering in the clouds, holding a long white ribbon. On the right and left, pairs of angels. A repeat work.

7320.d: Viis putot ja kaks delfiini laineharjadel. Üks putodest istub delfiini turjal, teised lamavais asendeis. Kordustöö.
7320.de: Five putti and two dolphins on wave crests. One of the putti sits on the back of a dolphin, the others in reclining poses. A repeat work.

7376.d: Ees vasakul kärestikuline jõgi, paremal kaldal järsk kaljumassiiv mille taga lehtpuumets.
7376.de: In front on the left a rapids river, on the right bank a steep rock massif behind which a deciduous forest.

7585.d: Esiplaanil veekogu ääres lõkketule ümber grupp mehi ja hobuseid, taamal mäed.
7585.de: In the foreground, by a body of water, a group of men and horses around a campfire, mountains in the distance.

7628.d: Mehe rinnakujutis peaaegu en face. Peas puuderdatud parukas. Üle parema õla sinine lai pael, kaelas valge šaboo ordeniga, teine orden rinnas.
7628.de: Bust portrait of a man almost en face. Powdered wig on his head. A broad blue ribbon over his right shoulder, a white jabot with an order at the neck, a second order on the chest.

7717.d: Ees keskel vahuste laineharjade vahel purjelaeva vrakk. Vasemal läbi laintevahu näha sadamamuul. Teos lõuni viimata
7717.de: In the centre foreground, a wreck of a sailing ship among foaming wave crests. On the left, a harbour mole visible through the foam of the waves. The work is unfinished

7817.d: Keskealise naise täisfiguur toolil istuvana, pööre 3/4 profiilis vasakule. Taustaks paremal punane draperii, vasakul üle balustraadi näha puude latvu.
7817.de: Half-length... wait, full figure of a middle-aged woman seated on a chair, turned 3/4 profile to the left. Background with red drapery on the right, on the left tree tops visible over a balustrade.

7818.d: Esialal keskel õu, milles kahe vankri juures mees hobusega, paremal lattaia ääres üksikud puud. Keskel vasakul punase telliskatusega kivimaja, mille taga ja kõrval linnamüüri torne. Tornidest paremal Toompea nõlvakule kerkiv linnamüür, milles nõlvaku jalal väravaava. Selle ees poollagunenud eelvärava ehitis, milles asuvat värava ava linna suunas läbib talunaine vankris. Paremal ülal, Toompea nõlval veel maju.
7818.de: In the foreground centre a yard in which a man with a horse stands by two carts, on the right by a plank fence solitary trees. In the centre left a stone house with a red tiled roof, behind and beside it towers of the town wall. To the right of the towers the town wall rising up the slope of Toompea, at the foot of the slope a gate opening. In front of it a half-ruined outer gate structure, through the gate opening leading towards the town a peasant woman passes in a cart. Above on the right, on the slope of Toompea, more houses.

7821.d: Esiplaanil nõlvak, vasemal ja paremal puud. Tagapool punase katusega ümarik kindlustustorn, Kiek in de Kök Tallinnas.
7821.de: In the foreground a slope, trees on the left and right. Behind, a round fortification tower with a red roof, Kiek in de Kök in Tallinn.

7823.d: Esiplaanil viljapõld kuue rukkilõikajaga: viis naist Hiiu valgetes, punaste peakatetega rahvariietes, vasakul mees kübaraga. Tagapoole põldu ääristav kiviaed ja tee viib külla. Pildi keskosas, suurte puude vahel kahekorruseline kelpkatusega valge hoone, sellest vasakul väiksem maja ja kooguga kaev, mille tagant paistmas terava tornikiivriga kirik. Ca 2/3 maali pinnast on rünkpilvine kõrge äikeseeelne taevas, heledad valguselaigud langevad rukkilõikajatele.
7823.de: In the foreground a grain field with six rye reapers: five women in white Hiiumaa folk costumes with red headwear, on the left a man with a hat. Behind, a stone wall borders the field and a road leads to the village. In the middle part of the picture, between large trees, a two-storey white building with a hipped roof, to its left a smaller house and a well with a sweep, behind which a church with a sharp spire is visible. About 2/3 of the painting's surface is a high, cumulus, pre-thunderstorm sky, bright patches of light falling on the rye reapers.

7843.d: Keskel ees must pikakarvaline koer, ilmse huviga jälgimas paremal õhus lendlevat kirjut liblikat, taustaks meri purjekatega kauguses.
7843.de: In the centre foreground a black long-haired dog, watching with evident interest a patterned butterfly fluttering in the air to the right, background a sea with sailboats in the distance.

7882.d: Ees veekogu, tagapool, kaldal oleva kindluse peegeldusega. Tagapool kivimüüri taga kõrge torniga kindlus.
7882.de: In front a body of water, with the reflection of a fortress on the bank behind it. Behind, beyond a stone wall, a fortress with a tall tower.

7950.d: Pilves taeva taustal paremal kõrge, järsk, lõhestatud ja alt õõnes pankkallas. Tagapool veepind, mille taustal rannal rusud. Mere kohal parv kajakaid.
7950.de: Against a cloudy sky background on the right a high, steep, cracked and hollow-based cliff bank. Behind it a water surface, on the background of which are ruins on the shore. Above the sea a flock of gulls.

8290.d: Antiikses rõivastuses naise poolfiguur profiilis vasakule, süles nuttev Amor.
8290.de: Half-figure of a woman in antique dress, in profile facing left, a weeping Amor in her lap.

8438.d: Kiviseinas ümar kaareline värav, millest avaneb vaade viljapõllule. Väravast siseneb eesti rahvariietes paljasjalgne naine, paremas käes sirp. Pildi vasakus servas istub maas rahvariietes naine, pilk väravast siseneja poole.
8438.de: In a stone wall a round arched gate, opening onto a view of a grain field. Through the gate enters a barefoot woman in Estonian national costume, a sickle in her right hand. At the left edge of the picture sits a woman in national costume on the ground, her gaze directed towards the one entering through the gate.

8440.d: Esiplaanil madal vesi, millesse keskel kaldalt astumas noor tumedajuukseline naine, kergitades parema käega oma punast pihikuga seelikut, mille ees põll. Põllel ülal- ja alaääres lai aplikatsioonitikand. Seljas sügava kaelalõikega pluus, kaelas kaherealine korall - helmekee. Vasakus käevangus tühi punasest vasest veekann, pea peal lamedapõhjaline korv, milles istub heledapäine laps. Naise kõrval vasakul tumedajuukseline poisike jalgupidi vees, parema käega kergitades oma särki üle naba, vasakuga hoides kinni naise seelikust. Tagaplaanil mägine maastik,  vasakul heidab suur lehtpuu  figuurigrupile mõningast varju, pilt üldiselt päikeseline.
8440.de: In the foreground, shallow water, into which, from the shore in the centre, a young dark-haired woman is stepping, lifting with her right hand her red-bodiced skirt, in front of which is an apron. On the apron, at the upper and lower edges, a broad appliqué embroidery. She wears a blouse with a deep neckline, on her neck a two-row coral bead necklace. In her left arm's crook an empty red copper water jug, on her head a flat-bottomed basket in which sits a fair-haired child. Next to the woman, on the left, a dark-haired little boy stands with his feet in the water, with his right hand lifting his shirt above his navel, with his left holding onto the woman's skirt. In the background a mountainous landscape; on the left a large deciduous tree casts some shade on the group of figures, the picture is generally sunny.

8486.d: Vana naise rinnapilt eestvaates. Pea kallutatud ettepoole, peas valge pitsääristusega tanu. Keskelt lahku kammitud juuksed ripuvad lahtiselt õlgadele. Seljas tume vammus ja valge laia kraega särk, mille kaelus kinnitatud ristsõlega.
8486.de: Bust portrait of an old woman, frontal view. Head tilted forward, wearing a bonnet with white lace trim. Hair parted in the middle hangs loose onto the shoulders. Wearing a dark jerkin and a white shirt with a wide collar, its neckline fastened with a cross-knot.

8705.dm: lehe kõrgus: 38.2 cm; lehe laius: 52.5 cm
8705.d: Esiplaanil olevate kõrgete kaljurahnude tippude vahelt vaade all orus olevale veekogule ja selle vastaskaldaks olevale lumisele mäeahelikule. Horisondil päikesest valgustatud mäeharjad.
8705.de: Through the peaks of the high cliff boulders in the foreground, a view of a body of water below in the valley and, on its opposite shore, a snowy mountain range. On the horizon sun-lit mountain ridges.

8746.d: Õhtune suvine maastik tumeda pilvise taevaga. Vasakus kuldlõikes õlgkatusega talumaja kõrge lävepakuga otsauksest väljuva lapsega, taamal paremal kaks rehehoonet ja väliköök, pildi paremas ääres puudegrupp puitaiaga; nende juures naine punase rätikuga peas. Esiplaanil paremas kuldlõikes kana poegadega, sellest paremal rebane kukega hambus. Pildi vasakus ääres puude vahel piirdeaiaga ümbritsetud õlgkatusega hoone. J. Köleri samateemalise akvarelliga võrreldes on erinevused väga üksikutes detailides.
8746.de: An evening summer landscape with a dark cloudy sky. In the left golden section, a straw-roofed farmhouse with a child emerging from the high-threshold end door; further back on the right two threshing barns and an outdoor kitchen, at the right edge of the picture a group of trees with a wooden fence; near them a woman with a red kerchief on her head. In the foreground, in the right golden section, a hen with chicks, to its right a fox with a rooster in its jaws. At the left edge of the picture, among the trees, a straw-roofed building surrounded by a fence. Compared to J. Köler's watercolour on the same theme, the differences are only in very few details.

8915.dm: kõrgus: 74.0 cm (arm, ovaal); laius: 59.0 cm (arm, ovaal)
8915.d: Vanema mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasakule. Kõrget laupa raamib tume, meelekohalt hallinev ja lagipeal hõre juus tahapoole kammituna. Nägu ilmestab tugev mokahabe. Seljas üherealine tumedast riidest pintsak, mis on ääristatud musta paelaga.
8915.de: Bust portrait of an older man in three-quarter profile to the left. The high forehead is framed by dark hair, greying at the temples and thin on the crown, combed back. The face is accentuated by a strong moustache. Wearing a single-breasted jacket of dark cloth, trimmed with black braid.

8971.d: Voki ees istuva noore naise figuur profiilis vasakule. Käed linakoonlast lõnga tõmbamas, parem jalg voki tallalaual. Hiiu naise rõivastus vaskvööga, mille küljes vasakul poolel noatupp ja nõelakodu. Tagaseinas vasakul avatud aken, millest näha väljas noort meest püsside vahel ära viidavat.
8971.de: The figure of a young woman sitting at a spinning wheel, in profile facing left. Her hands drawing thread from a linen distaff, her right foot on the wheel's treadle. The Hiiumaa woman's attire includes a copper belt, on the left side of which hangs a knife sheath and a needle case. In the back wall on the left an open window, through which a young man can be seen being led away between rifles outside.

9007.d: Naise rinnapilt profiilis vasakule. Rikkalikel blondidel juustel kollane lilleline tanu, samast materjalist varrukate ülaosa, mustal vestil valge žaboo jämeda kuldketiga.
9007.de: A bust portrait of a woman in profile to the left. On her rich blonde hair a yellow floral bonnet, the upper part of the sleeves of the same material, a white jabot with a thick gold chain on a black vest.

9040.d: Keskealise mehe põlvpilt istuvas asendis, poolprofiilis vasakule. Täishabe ja vurrud. Seljas sinine kuub.
9040.de: Knee-length portrait of a middle-aged man in a sitting position, in half-profile to the left. Full beard and moustache. Wearing a blue coat.

9052.d: Hallijuukselise rauga rinnapilt eestvaates. Põskhabemest piiratud nägu kallutatud ettepoole, silmad suletud. Seljas valge särk, mille kaelus kinnitatud ristsõlega ja tume kuub.
9052.de: Bust portrait of a grey-haired old man, frontal view. Face framed by side-whiskers, tilted forward, eyes closed. Wearing a white shirt with the collar fastened with a cross-knot, and a dark coat.

9205.d: Võlvitud keldris, millesse vasakus ülemises nurgas olevast aknaavast langeb nõrka valgust, kaks mehefiguuri tegevuses nende vahel oleva pooleldi avatud kirstu ees. Vasakpoolne figuur  vaimuliku rüüs hoiab paremas käes laternat, vasakus paksu raamatut. Parempoolne, ilmselt noore mehe figuur, poolkummargil kirstu kohal, hoiab paremas käes mingisugust laternatule valguses kiirgavat eset, kuna vasakuga asetab midagi vaimuliku käes olevale raamatule. Meeste vahel oleva kirstu poolavali kaane alt upitub välja ronima seal lamanud kuju. Tagaplaanil vasakul teisi kirste, mis on ka lahti kistud. Visand tehtud mustaga grisaille-tehnikas.
9205.de: In a vaulted cellar, into which weak light falls from a window opening in the upper left corner, two male figures engaged in an activity in front of a half-open coffin between them. The left-hand figure, in clerical robes, holds a lantern in his right hand and a thick book in his left. The right-hand figure, apparently a young man, half-bent over the coffin, holds in his right hand some object glowing in the light of the lantern, while with his left he places something on the book held by the clergyman. From under the half-open lid of the coffin between the men, a figure that had been lying there is pushing itself up to climb out. In the background on the left, other coffins, also pried open. The sketch is done in black in the grisaille technique.

9223.d: Esiplaanil vasakul jõekallas kahe inimfiguuriga ja suurte puudega. Paremal vesi, tagaplaanil mets.

9253.dm: kujutise laius: 22.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 23.1 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 17.9 cm; lehe laius: 30.6 cm
9253.d: Esiplaanil tee ja põllud. Taga üle põõsastiku vaade eluhoonete katustele ja kirikule nende keskel. Kujutis ovaalis.
9253.de: A road and fields in the foreground. Behind, a view over shrubbery of the roofs of dwellings and a church among them. The image is in an oval.

9337.d: Ees meri - vasakul aurik ja paremal sõudepaat. Tagapool keskel purjekas. Tagaplaanil silmapiiril Tallinna siluett.
9337.de: In front, the sea - on the left a steamer and on the right a rowing boat. In the middle background a sailing boat. In the far background on the horizon the silhouette of Tallinn.

9506.d: Punases mütsikeses habemiku vanamehe rinnapilt. Pea kummardatud alla. Seljas tumepruun mungarüü.
9506.de: Bust portrait of a bearded old man in a red cap. Head bowed down. Wearing a dark brown monk's robe.

9511.d: Ees kaljud, neist vasakul kõrgemad, keskmisel rahnul istuv kotkas, taga keskel mägine maastik, millest paremal ja vasemal silmapiirini laiuv meri, kaugustes paistvate purjekatega. Taevas pilvine.
9511.de: In front, rocks, of which the ones on the left are higher, on the middle boulder an eagle sitting, behind, in the centre, a mountainous landscape, from which, on the right and left, the sea stretches to the horizon, with sailing boats visible in the distance. The sky cloudy.

9518.dm: laius: 51.5 cm (arm); kõrgus: 59.7 cm (ovaal); kõrgus: 62.5 cm (arm); laius: 49.5 cm (ovaal)
9518.d: Punasel foonil, millele on kullatud kartongiga antud ovaalne vorm, naise rindportree profiilis vasakule. Juuksed kuklasse kammitud, tumedal kleidil valge krae, ümber kaela kahes reas pärlid.
9518.de: On a red background, on which an oval form is given in gilded cardboard, a woman's chest portrait in profile to the left. Hair combed into a bun at the back, white collar on the dark dress, a two-row string of pearls around the neck.

9528.d: Esiplaanil rohtunud järsu kalda serv üksiku meesfiguuriga. Keskel näha kalda langusel ja orus kasvava lehtmetsa ladvastikku. Kaugemal jõgi tõusva vastaskaldaga.
9528.de: In the foreground the edge of a steep, overgrown bank with a solitary male figure. In the centre, the treetops of a deciduous forest growing on the slope and in the valley below are visible. Further away a river with a rising opposite bank.

9542.d: Noore pikajuukselise mehe poolfiguur, jeha pöördega paremale, nägu en face, vaade suunatud üles, rohelist tooni rüü. Paremal, laual avatud raamat ja mehe käte vahel pärgamendi rull. Tagapool karikas, millest kerkib üles madu.
9542.de: Half-figure of a young long-haired man, torso turned to the right, face en face, gaze directed upward, wearing a robe of green tone. On the right, on a table, an open book, and between the man's hands a scroll of parchment. Behind, a chalice from which a serpent rises.

9596.d: Ovaali komponeeritud noore naise rinnaportree, pea pöördes paremale, pilk üle õla veidi küljele-alla suunatud. Naisel pehmed näojooned, tumedad silmad, sirge nina, kulmujoon. Keskelt lahkukammitud pikad lokilised ruuged juuksed langevad paljastatud õlgadele, juustes paremal erksavärvilised õied: edelveiss, moon, rukkilill rohelise oksaga. Ümber õlgade hele läbipaistev sall-rõivas. Summutatud pruunikad, hõbedased toonid, pehme akadeemiline kujutamisviis. Kuju sulandub fooni, valgus suunatud näole, õlale. Nikerdatud ovaalne puitraam.
9596.de: A bust portrait of a young woman composed within an oval, the head turned to the right, the gaze directed slightly to the side and down, over the shoulder. The woman has soft facial features, dark eyes, a straight nose, an eyebrow line. Long curly reddish-blond hair, parted in the middle, falls onto her bared shoulders; in her hair, on the right, brightly coloured flowers: edelweiss, poppy, cornflower with a green twig. A light transparent scarf-garment is wrapped around her shoulders. Muted brownish, silvery tones, a soft academic manner of depiction. The figure blends into the background, the light directed onto the face and shoulder. Carved oval wooden frame.

9693.d: Mehe rinnapilt, kolmveerand profiilis paremale; vurrude ja täishabemega.
9693.de: Bust portrait of a man, in three-quarter profile to the right; with a moustache and full beard.

9721.d: Esiplaanil vasakul jõekallas laudadest teega ja puudega tagapool. Jõe keskel saareke puuga. Paremal kaldal puud ja künkal kaks mehefiguuri. Taga mets ja kirik.
9721.de: In the foreground on the left a riverbank with a path of planks and trees further back. In the middle of the river a small island with a tree. On the right bank trees and on a hillock two male figures. Behind, forest and a church.

9765.d: Esiplaanil rohtunud rannaäär. Kaugemal kitsas mereriba kolme paadiga. Taevas kaetud pilvedag. All vasakus nurgas kiri: Hapba.
9765.de: In the foreground a grassy shoreline. Further away a narrow strip of sea with three boats. The sky covered with clouds. In the lower left corner an inscription: Hapba.

9769.d: Esiplaanil vasemal karjapoiss lammaste ja koeraga, keskel keerudes sügavusse suunatud teel rahvariides naine selgvaates, paremal nõmmemaastik üksikute põõsastega. Nende taga veekogu (järvesopp), mille vastaskaldal lehtpuude rühmi ja üksik taluhoone. Keskel vasemal üksikute tammede taga taluhooneid, nende kohal teel kaks meest. Taamal asuv mets liitub järve tagakaldal asuvate puuderühmadega. Taevas pilvine.
9769.de: In the foreground on the left a shepherd boy with sheep and a dog, in the centre on a winding road leading into the depth a woman in folk costume seen in profile, on the right a heath landscape with solitary bushes. Behind them a body of water (a bay of a lake), on whose opposite shore groups of deciduous trees and a solitary farm building. In the centre left, behind solitary oaks, farm buildings, above them on the road two men. The forest in the distance merges with the groups of trees on the far shore of the lake. The sky is cloudy.

9838.d: Esiplaanil murul lapsed, vasakul põld ja talumajad, paremal kõrgendikul puud, taamal meri.
9838.de: Children on the grass in the foreground, a field and farmhouses on the left, trees on a rise on the right, the sea beyond.

10029.d: Esiplaanil vasakul vanad kõrged puud. Keskel käänuline jõgi veskitammiga ja veskihoonetega paremal kaldal. Samas näha ka teisi hooneid osalt varjatuna puudetukast. Paremal kallast pidi üles viiv teerada naise figuuriga. Esiplaanil jõel tühi paat. Taeval valkjas - hallikad pilved. Keskosas paistab kauge silmapiir.
10029.de: In the foreground on the left old tall trees. In the middle a winding river with a mill dam and mill buildings on the right bank. Also visible are other buildings, partly hidden by a clump of trees. On the right a path leading up along the bank with a woman's figure. In the foreground an empty boat on the river. Sky whitish-greyish clouds. In the central part a distant horizon is visible.

10054.d: Vana naise portree poolprofiilis vasemale, valge kraega tumepruunis kleidis, musta jämedakoelise pitsiga kaela ümber ja varrukal õla juures. Peas valge õhuke kroogetega tanu, mis paljastab eest keskelt lahku kammitud hallikad juuksed, rohelise paelaga lõua alt kinni kuldne pross. Tumeroheline foon.
10054.de: Portrait of an old woman in half-profile to the left, in a dark brown dress with a white collar, with coarse black lace around the neck and at the shoulder of the sleeve. On her head a thin white pleated bonnet, revealing greyish hair parted in the middle at the front, a golden brooch fastened under the chin with a green ribbon. Dark green background.

10139.d: Mõtliku ilmega noore naise rinnaportree pöördes paremale. Ruuged juuksed kukla taga sõlmes, kõrvas tumeda ovaalse kiviga kõrvarõngas. Seljas valge õhuline kleit ning ümber õlgade läbipaistev sall.
10139.de: Bust portrait of a thoughtful-looking young woman turned to the right. Auburn hair tied in a knot at the back of the head, an earring with a dark oval stone in the ear. Wearing a white airy dress and a transparent shawl around the shoulders.

10263.d: Vasakul tumedapinnaline mägijärv paadiga, paremal valgustatud kruusasel kaldal naine, kahel pool mäed puudega, tagaplaanil lumised kõrged mäed.
10263.de: On the left a dark-surfaced mountain lake with a boat, on the right a woman on an illuminated gravelly shore, mountains with trees on both sides, high snowy mountains in the background.

10265.d: Karusnahkses mütsis hallipäise habemiku mehe rinnapilt peaaegu en face. Vaade suunatud vasakule.
10265.de: Bust portrait of a grey-haired bearded man in a fur cap, almost en face. Gaze directed to the left.

10338.de: Oval painted portrait of a man looking to the right, short hair combed smoothly back, moustache and side-whiskers. Background greyish, brownish above the shoulders.

25509.d: Tallinna vaade Väikese Rannavärava poolt. Esiplaanil kinnikasvanud vallikraavi säng, millest viib üle kivist sillake Väikese Rannavärava poole. Taamal Tallinna katuste ja tornide siluetid, paremal taga Oleviste kiriku torn. Olevistest paremal Paks Margareta, selle ees 17. sajandist pärinev bastion.(eesti)
25509.de: A view of Tallinn from the side of the Väike Rannavärav (Small Beach Gate). In the foreground the bed of an overgrown moat, across which a small stone bridge leads towards the Väike Rannavärav. Beyond, the silhouettes of Tallinn's roofs and towers, on the right in the back the tower of St. Olaf's Church (Oleviste). To the right of Oleviste, Paks Margareeta (Fat Margaret), in front of it a bastion dating from the 17th century.

25510.dm: laius: 12.5 cm (plaat); kõrgus: 25.7 cm (leht); laius: 21.0 cm (leht); kõrgus: 17.0 cm (plaat)
25510.d: Tallinna vaade Nunnavärava poolt. Vasakul ees võsastunud rohumaa, paremalt keskele viib sild üle vallikraavi läbi väravate, mille juures paistab ka vahimajake. Vasakul taga linnamüüri ja raekoja tornid. Keskel taga kerkib Toompea nõlv ilma treppide ja teedeta. Ülal keskel klassitsistlik kohtuhoone, sellest paremal Toomkiriku tornikiiver. Esiplaanil linna viival teel liiguvad jalutajate grupid, kahehobusekaless sõitjatega eemaldub linnast.
25510.de: A view of Tallinn from the side of Nunna Gate. On the left in front, overgrown grassland, from the right towards the centre a bridge leads over the moat through the gates, near which a guardhouse can also be seen. On the left in the back, the towers of the city wall and town hall. In the middle behind, the slope of Toompea rises without stairs or paths. Above in the middle, a classicist courthouse, to the right of it the spire of the Dome Church. In the foreground, groups of pedestrians moving along the road leading into the city, a two-horse carriage with passengers moving away from the city.

25518.d: Tartu Ülikooli klassitsistlik peahoone vaadatuna Ülikooli tänava nurgalt. Ülikooli ees liikumas peamiselt mundris üliõpilased. Sõiduteel kahehobuserakendiga kaless ohvitseriga. Koer jookseb hobuste ees. Vasakul ees kolm üliõpilast. Paremal härra ja daam ületamas sõiduteed. Taamal Jaani tänava majad ja Jaani kiriku torn kellaga. (eesti)
25518.de: The Neoclassical main building of the University of Tartu viewed from the corner of Ülikooli Street. In front of the university, mostly uniformed students are moving about. On the roadway a two-horse carriage with an officer. A dog runs in front of the horses. On the left in the foreground three students. On the right a gentleman and lady crossing the road. In the distance the houses of Jaani Street and the tower of St John's Church with a clock.

25519.d: Saadjärve maastik. Esiplaanil järve kallas kuue lehma ja karjasega. Vasakul puud, paremal kolm noort sirget puud. Järve teisel kaldal Saadjärve mõisa valged kivihooned: vasakul torniga peahoone, paremal kivist poolkelp-katusega elamu.(eesti)
25519.de: Saadjärve landscape. In the foreground the lake shore with six cows and a herdsman. On the left trees, on the right three young straight trees. On the other shore of the lake the white stone buildings of Saadjärve manor: on the left the main building with a tower, on the right a stone dwelling with a half-hip roof.
